content:
anya: Heads-up — onboarding Orpheus-7B (int4) showed a non-obvious quality regression on our summarization canary after quant calibration. Short thread.

anya: FP16 ppl ~11.5, int4 calibrated ppl ~12.0, but abstractive ROUGE down ~5-7 pts and outputs truncate/repeat.

mike: paste conversion + quant settings?

anya: conversion: NFKC normalization, preserved ids where possible; mapped a few rare unicode to closest codepoints. quant: per-channel, asymmetric off, clip_pct=99.9, calibrate_batches=300.

sam: quick hypothesis: projection layout permutation. Some Orpheus checkpoints store qkv as interleaved heads, but our loader expects block layout. That misroutes rotary phases.

leslie: also check token id collisions post-normalization. If two codepoints collapse to same id, prefix/KV cache behavior can be corrupted and cause short outputs on long prompts.

anya: ran two fast experiments: 1) apply head-interleave->block permute on q/k/v slices; 2) revert normalization merges for the few rare chars.

anya: results: permute alone recovered most ROUGE (~+4.5 pts) and ppl back to ~11.6. Fixing tokenmap dedupe gave small extra gain and removed repeat loops.

ci-bot: ci job queued: orpheus-onboard/debug-1789990000 (permute + tokenmap-smoke). ETA ~ 11m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: plan: add a small conversion heuristic to detect layout (shape + metadata flag) and fallback to a quick two-way smoke ppl test if ambiguous. Also add tokenmap-dup histogram check in conversion tool.

mike: I'll add a loader assert and an opt-in auto-permute with a noisy warning. Also add a conversion report listing any normalization collisions.

leslie: add onboarding checklist entries: "verify qkv proj layout" and "tokenmap collision check". We should also gate int4 onboard CI on a summarization canary to catch regressions early.

anya: PR with loader permute and tokenmap check coming up. Assigning to @mike for review.

mike: will review this afternoon. Nice rapid debug. :thumbsup:

anya: thanks — I’ll keep the triage ticket open until full eval finishes.
